jobs.title: Head of Market Intelligence & Analytics
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**  

At Northland, we’re enablers of change, united by our journey to transform the energy sector into the foundation for a sustainable future.


Since our inception, we’ve been early movers in the energy industry, adopting new initiatives that pave the way for communities across the globe and helping forge their path towards a carbon\-neutral landscape.


We’re a different kind of independent power producer. As developers, owners and operators who are at the forefront of the energy transition, we’re uniquely positioned to leave a lasting impact in the regions where we operate. We’ve expanded our business across Canada, the United States, Latin America, Europe and Asia to become a global leader, all by bringing together industry experts to find solutions with an entrepreneurial mindset.


While our work powers communities across the globe, **Northland is powered by our people.**

What You’ll Do:
  

  

The Head of Market Intelligence \& Analytics is accountable for building and leading Northland’s enterprise market intelligence and analytics capabilities. The role establishes independent, decision\-ready views of wholesale power and related commodity markets, translates those views into consistent commercial assumptions, and ensures those insights are applied across strategy, development, M\&A, financing, market operations, asset management and portfolio optimization.
  

  

Establish scalable in\-house forecasting and modelling capabilities, guide market analysts and technical resources, and determine where external specialists remain appropriate. The successful candidate combines deep electricity\-market judgment, strong quantitative fluency, practical model\-development oversight and the ability to communicate complex market dynamics to executive and investment audiences.
  

  

Build a global centre of expertise that protects, optimizes and sustainably grows the commercial value of Northland’s contracted and merchant portfolio, while underpinning new development opportunities with rigorous market intelligence, forward curves, fundamental analysis, scenario modelling and asset\-level commercial insight. The initial priority is to establish repeatable capabilities for core markets and then scale them across Northland’s broader international portfolio.
  

  

The role is required to work in the Toronto office 4 days per week with one flexible day to work from home.
Key Responsibilities:  



  

Market Intelligence


* Working with the Director of Regulatory \& Market Affairs, lead the development of Northland’s wholesale market strategy across relevant jurisdictions, identifying long\-term trends, structural opportunities, downside risks and implications for capital allocation.
* Develop and maintain internal views on supply and demand evolution, market design, natural gas, carbon, capacity, ancillary services, environmental attributes and other material value drivers.
* Create a consistent market\-outlook and assumption\-setting process for use across business cases, investment decisions, budgets, forecasts and commercial strategies.
* Working with the Director of Regulatory \& Market Affairs, translate market, policy and regulatory developments into alerts and actionable recommendations for internal stakeholders.

Forecasting, Modelling and Analytics


* Own the roadmap and delivery of internal forward curves (short and long term), market\-level fundamental models and supporting analytical tools, beginning with priority markets and scaling as business needs and capability mature.
* Set modelling architecture, scenarios, input assumptions and quality standards; provide sufficient technical depth to review, challenge and guide Python\-based and commercial\-platform model development.
* Develop scenario and sensitivity analysis covering load growth, generation additions and retirements, fuel and carbon prices, weather, transmission build\-out, policy, technology costs, capture rates and operating constraints.
* Build dashboards and repeatable reporting that make market views, assumptions, risks and forecast changes transparent and accessible to decision\-makers.

Asset, Portfolio and Transaction Decision Support


* Lead market analysis supporting development, acquisitions, divestitures, financing, budgeting and optimization of operating assets, including merchant revenue forecasts and high\-level asset valuations.
* Provide dispatch, capture\-price, congestion, basis, curtailment, ancillary\-service and other commercial analyses appropriate to each market, technology and contract structure.
* Support hedging decisions, PPA and offtake strategy, competitive bid and RFP analysis, route\-to\-market decisions, commercial operating strategies and portfolio risk discussions.
* Partner with Finance and transaction teams on lender, sale and investment processes, using independent third\-party forecasts where external validation is required while maintaining a clear Northland view.

Capability, Data and Model Governance


* Establish a practical build\-versus\-buy strategy for data, tools, modelling platforms and external advisory support, with clear accountabilities, budgets and service standards.
* Implement model governance covering documentation, version control, assumption ownership, change management, validation, back\-testing \[CS3\.1]and independent challenge proportionate to the decision being supported.
* Define data requirements and partner with Technical Performance Management, Data, Digital and IT teams to develop reliable and scalable market\-data infrastructure.
* Manage relationships with market\-data providers, modelling vendors and consultants; reduce avoidable external dependence while retaining specialist support where it adds value or is required by third parties.

jobs.title: AVP, Strategic Programs, Innovation, Insights and Regulatory Operations
jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues \- experts in their fields \- who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients \- who are at the heart of everything we do.  



  

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.  



  

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.  



  

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.  



  

**Job Description:**

The AVP, Strategic Programs, Innovation, Insights \& Regulatory Operations provides executive leadership across Strategic Initiatives \& Innovation, Data \& Insights, Registration \& Licensing, and Governance Programs \& Initiatives. The role integrates regulatory execution, governance and control frameworks, modernization, portfolio delivery and business priorities through a common strategy, roadmap and operating model.  



The AVP sets priorities, allocates resources, leads the Director team, and ensures initiatives move from concept through adoption and sustainable ownership. The role balances regulatory defensibility, operational risk, advisor and client experience, efficiency, capacity and responsible use of digital, automation, analytics, AI and emerging technologies.  



**What will you do?**

  

* Strong knowledge of Canadian wealth and insurance distribution, securities and insurance regulatory requirements, dealer obligations and first\-line supervisory expectations.· Experience operating in a federally regulated financial institution, ideally within an OSFI\-regulated environment and across a three\-lines\-of\-defence model.
* Demonstrated success leading leaders and multidisciplinary teams through complex operational, regulatory and organizational change.
* Proven ability to translate regulatory change, audit findings, control gaps and business risks into practical operating\-model, process, technology and governance solutions.
* Advanced portfolio\-management capability, including prioritization, governance, benefits realization, resource planning and executive reporting.
Exceptional judgment, strategic thinking, stakeholder influence, executive communication and ability to challenge constructively in a complex matrixed organization.  
* 

  

**What do you need to succeed?**

  

Significant progressive leadership experience (10 years\+) in financial services, ideally spanning wealth, insurance, governance, regulatory operations, compliance, risk, transformation or technology\-enabled change.  

* 

**Strategy, Portfolio, Executive Partnership and Change Leadership**

* Set and execute an integrated multi\-year strategy and roadmap aligned to BG\&C and RA\&S priorities, regulatory obligations, business outcomes and investment capacity.
* Establish disciplined portfolio governance for intake, prioritization, sequencing, benefits realization, executive reporting and transition to business ownership.
* Advise senior leaders on outcomes, trade\-offs, dependencies, risks, capability gaps and required decisions or escalations.
Build enterprise partnerships and lead portfolio\-level change through clear direction, stakeholder engagement, communication, training, adoption and accountability.  
* 

**Governance, Regulatory Execution and First\-Line Oversight**

* Strengthen regulatory defensibility and first\-line ownership by embedding practical governance, control and supervision capabilities across the portfolio.
* Establish, embed and maintain governance and control frameworks that support regulatory compliance, effective first\-line oversight, advisor/client outcomes and sustainable business ownership.
* Lead applicable regulatory change execution from horizon scanning and impact assessment through business requirements, implementation, adoption and evidence of sustainable compliance.
* Oversee attestations, audit/regulatory findings, remediation commitments and management action plans to ensure timely, complete and sustainable closure.
Ensure field leaders, advisors and business partners receive clear guidance, communications and training to support adoption of applicable governance, regulatory and operational expectations.  
* 

**Transformation, Innovation, Insights and Regulatory Operations**

* Develop and execute the modernization roadmap across process and operating\-model redesign, technology, analytics, automation, AI and GenAI\-enabled capabilities.
* Provide executive oversight of registration and licensing operations, ensuring clear accountability, documented decisions, effective controls and alignment with regulatory and business requirements.
* Set direction for analytics, dashboards and performance measures that connect regulatory risk, advisor and client experience and business outcomes.
Sponsor discovery through scaling, using evidence\-based criteria to stop, iterate or expand solutions while ensuring adoption, controls and sustainable ownership.  
* 

  

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Scientific Strategy
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **The Klick Group**—comprising Klick Health (including Oxford PharmaGenesis, Klick Katalyst, and btwelve), Klick Media, Klick Applied Sciences (including Klick Labs), and Klick Consulting—is an ecosystem dedicated help life sciences brands achieve their full potential through best\-in\-class marketing and advertising, media, medical affairs and communications, market access, real\-world evidence, and technology and analytics consulting — powered by 500\+ in\-house medical experts and award\-winning data science and AI capabilities. Founded in 1997, we have offices in Toronto, New York, Oxford, London, Cambridge, Cardiff, Melbourne, Philadelphia, Saratoga Springs, São Paulo, and Singapore. One of the most\-awarded health agencies on the planet, Klick is consistently recognized for its people\-first culture as a Great Place to Work, Best Workplace for Women, Best Workplace for Inclusion, Most Admired Corporate Culture, and FORTUNE Best Workplace in Advertising. Klick also recently made history as Cannes Lions Healthcare Agency of the Year, Healthcare Network of the Year, and Independent Agency of the Year – Health.

**About our Medical Communications \& Innovation Craft**  

The Medical Communications \& Innovation craft integrates scientific depth with modern communication approaches to bring clinical stories to life. We shape scientific narratives, translate complex evidence into meaningful engagement, and guide clients through emerging trends in scientific exchange. Our work spans medical writing, strategy, and innovation to support impactful, compliant, and credible communication across therapeutic areas.

 **Job Description**  

The Associate Director, Scientific Strategy blends advanced scientific communication with growing strategic leadership. This role contributes to both content development and scientific planning, supporting integrated medical communications initiatives across multiple therapeutic areas. The ideal candidate brings strong scientific acumen, independent writing capability, and an interest in helping shape forward\-thinking engagement strategies alongside senior leaders.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Develop scientifically accurate, compelling content across formats, ensuring clarity, integrity, and alignment with project objectives.
* Conduct literature reviews and synthesize complex data into clear narratives that support scientific platforms and communication strategies.
* Lead project briefs and provide guidance that enables cross\-functional teams to execute high\-quality medical communications deliverables.
* Collaborate with senior strategists to support planning for advisory boards, workshops, and other strategic initiatives.
* Engage directly with clients as a scientific partner, contributing to presentations, discussions, and opportunities for account growth.

  

**Qualifications** **Required:**

* 5\+ years of experience in medical communications, medical education, or related scientific communication roles.
* Proven ability to develop high\-quality medical content across therapeutic areas.
* Strong scientific literacy with the ability to learn new therapeutic areas quickly.
* Experience synthesizing literature, data, and clinical insights into clear, accurate narratives.
* Excellent communication skills and confidence presenting to internal and client teams.
* Ability to manage multiple deliverables independently while meeting quality and timeline expectations.

**Desired:**

* Scientific degree, with PhD or MD preferred.
* Experience supporting strategic planning or advisory board development.
* Prior involvement in new business proposals or pitch participation.
* Interest in evolving into a broader strategic leadership role.
* Comfort working with digital or innovative formats for scientific communication.
* Enthusiasm for integrating AI into scientific and strategic workflows.

  

**Additional Information**  

This posting is for a newly created role at Klick.


The base salary range for this position is between CAD $125,000 \- $150,000\. The final amount offered will be determined based on several factors such as a candidate’s work location, their unique skill set, education, and prior work experience.


\#LI\-MK1 \#LI\-Hybrid

***Our Commitment to Inclusion***  

  

*Klick is consciously creating a culture where everyone can thrive and grow in their careers. We believe that our best work comes from our diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We strongly encourage members of historically underrepresented communities to apply, including Black people, Indigenous peoples, and other people of color, people with disabilities, people from gender and sexually diverse communities and people with intersectional identities. We're also committed to developing an inclusive, barrier\-free recruitment process and work environment. Should you require any accommodation, please contact us at careers@klick.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs and ensure you have a positive experience.*

jobs.title: Senior Director, Data & Analytics
jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY BACKGROUND \& CULTURE
  
UPP is the first pension plan of its kind in Ontario’s university sector, proudly serving over 46,000 members across six universities and nineteen sector organizations. Our purpose is to bring greater retirement peace of mind to the university sector by investing with integrity and serving members with care. As a sector\-wide plan designed for growth, our doors are open to all Ontario universities.
  
UPP is recognized as one of Greater Toronto’s Top Employers for 2026\. Together, we’re a team of progressive thinkers and agile doers operating within a fast\-paced culture of collaboration and respect. We believe in bringing smart and capable people together to create, solve, and grow with a clear shared vision and values of integrity, inclusivity, ingenuity, and impact.
  
Our culture is intentionally welcoming and purposefully rooted in equity, diversity, inclusion, and reconciliation (EDI\&R). We believe diverse teams, perspectives, and lived experiences contribute to better decisions and a better workplace.
  
As a pension plan, UPP approaches investing through a long\-term lens to generate and safeguard value. Our commitment to investing responsibly accounts for material risks that impact our investment portfolio to generate sufficient risk\-adjusted returns to meet the pension needs of our members.
  
Join us in building a bright future for our members, our organization, and each other.
  
  

THE ROLE
  
We are seeking a forward\-looking Senior Director, Data \& Analytics to lead and evolve UPP’s enterprise data capabilities. Reporting to the Managing Director, Data and Technology, this role will work with business and technology leaders to improve how data is governed, integrated, managed and used across UPP. Its scope includes data in UPP’s enterprise data hub and across the broader cloud solutions ecosystem, including Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The Senior Director will help ensure data is trusted, accessible and fit for business reporting, analytics, automation and emerging AI workloads.
  
This is an opportunity for an experienced data leader to shape an important enterprise capability and help UPP make better use of its data as the organization grows.
  
This role is based in downtown Toronto under a hybrid work policy, allowing employees the flexibility to work remotely and in\-office (two days per week in\-office).
  
This posting is for an existing vacancy.
  
SPECIFIC ACCOUNTABILITIES
  
The Senior Director, Data \& Analytics will lead and evolve UPP’s data capabilities, including the following:
  
* Develop and evolve UPP’s enterprise data strategy and practices so data is well governed, reliable, discoverable and useful across the organization.
* Lead and develop a high\-performing team responsible for data quality, data engineering, data integration, data operations and analytics enablement.
* Establish data standards and practices in partnership with business data owners, Architecture, Cybersecurity and other technology teams.
* Guide the use of cloud\-based data capabilities, including GCP, to support reliable data integration, reporting and analytics. Improve data quality, access, lineage and governance so data is ready for responsible automation and AI workloads, in partnership with the teams accountable for AI platforms, architecture, privacy and cybersecurity.
* Partner with business and technology leaders to prioritize data needs and enable trusted, data\-informed decisions. Establish the access patterns, tools, standards, training and controls that allow business users, including citizen data users, to work with data safely and at scale.
* Improve the reliability, quality, reuse and maintainability of data integration and transformation flows that support key processes, including pension data conversion, regular employer reporting, and Finance reporting and analysis.
* Leverage leading frameworks (such as DCAM) to continually mature and evolve the data strategy and frequently self\-asses the capabilities for progress
* Define and communicate data priorities, target capabilities and roadmaps, aligning plans with enterprise needs and available capacity.
* Research and establish peer connections to understand industry trends and their applicability to support data plans and strategies for the enterprise
* Explain the value of trusted data and sound data management practices to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Oversee UPP’s data catalog and related metadata practices, working with Architecture and data owners to improve data discoverability and stewardship.
* Contribute to UPP’s reputation as a respectful employer, partner, and participant in the financial sector


QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE
  
* 10\+ years of demonstrated experience developing and leading enterprise data capabilities, including data governance, data engineering, integration, data operations and analytics.
* CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional) or an equivalent qualification is an asset.
* Significant progressive experience in data management, including data governance, architecture, integration, data quality, metadata and analytics.
* Experience leading data teams or capabilities in a cloud\-based environment, with sufficient technical understanding of data platforms, databases, integration and transformation tools, analytics and visualization to set direction and make informed decisions. Experience with GCP or comparable cloud data platforms is an asset.
* Understanding of relational and non\-relational data and the considerations involved in integrating and governing different data types.
* Experience working across complex business domains; experience in pensions, investments or financial services is an asset.
* Experience designing and evolving cloud\-based data capabilities in partnership with internal teams and external service providers.
* Working knowledge of analytics methods and the interpretation of quantitative information.
